name: Phinehas
overview: Phinehas, the son of Eleazar and grandson of Aaron the high priest, is noted in Scripture for his zealous act in halting a plague among the Israelites by decisively punishing an Israelitish man and woman who had committed a grievous sin (Numbers 25:7-8). His fervent zeal for God's honor turned away divine wrath from the people, demonstrating the serious responsibility of spiritual leadership and mediation (Numbers 25:11). As a chief of the Korahite Levites and a high priestly figure, Phinehas also played roles in Israel's military and religious life, including sounding trumpets in battle and inquiring about monuments erected by the tribes (Exodus 6:25).
